mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT re.code AS resource_code, op.code AS operation_code, ram.service_code, ram.http_method, ram.path_pattern, ram.match_order FROM user_role ur INNER JOIN abstract_user au ON au.id = ur.abstract_user_id AND au.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND au.delete_flag = 0 INNER JOIN abstract_role ar ON ar.id = ur.abstract_role_id AND ar.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND ar.delete_flag = 0 INNER JOIN role_resource_permission rrp ON rrp.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND rrp.abstract_role_id = ur.abstract_role_id AND rrp.delete_flag = 0 AND rrp.condition_id IS NULL INNER JOIN resource_entity re ON re.id = rrp.resource_entity_id AND re.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND re.delete_flag = 0 INNER JOIN operation_permission op ON op.id = rrp.operation_permission_id AND op.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND op.delete_flag = 0 INNER JOIN resource_api_mapping ram ON ram.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND ram.resource_entity_id = rrp.resource_entity_id AND ram.delete_flag = 0 AND ram.enabled = TRUE WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.abstract_user_id = #{abstractUserId} AND ur.delete_flag = 0 AND (ur.valid_from IS NULL OR ur.valid_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (ur.valid_to IS NULL OR ur.valid_to >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM permission_conflict_rule cr INNER JOIN role_resource_permission rrp_other ON rrp_other.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND rrp_other.abstract_role_id = ur.abstract_role_id AND rrp_other.resource_entity_id = rrp.resource_entity_id AND rrp_other.delete_flag = 0 AND rrp_other.condition_id IS NULL AND (rrp_other.operation_permission_id = cr.first_operation_permission_id OR rrp_other.operation_permission_id = cr.second_operation_permission_id) WHERE cr.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND cr.delete_flag = 0 AND (cr.resource_type_value IS NULL OR cr.resource_type_value = re.resource_type) AND (cr.biz_domain_id IS NULL OR cr.biz_domain_id = re.biz_domain_id) AND (rrp.operation_permission_id = cr.first_operation_permission_id OR rrp.operation_permission_id = cr.second_operation_permission_id) AND rrp_other.operation_permission_id <> rrp.operation_permission_id ) ORDER BY ram.match_order ASC, ram.id ASC, re.code ASC, op.code ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM user_role ur INNER JOIN abstract_user au ON au.id = ur.abstract_user_id AND au.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND au.delete_flag = 0 INNER JOIN abstract_role ar ON ar.id = ur.abstract_role_id AND ar.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND ar.delete_flag = 0 INNER JOIN role_resource_permission rrp ON rrp.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND rrp.abstract_role_id = ur.abstract_role_id AND rrp.delete_flag = 0 AND rrp.condition_id IS NULL INNER JOIN resource_entity re ON re.id = rrp.resource_entity_id AND re.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND re.delete_flag = 0 INNER JOIN operation_permission op ON op.id = rrp.operation_permission_id AND op.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND op.delete_flag = 0 WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.abstract_user_id = #{abstractUserId} AND ur.delete_flag = 0 AND re.code = #{resourceCode} AND op.code = #{operationCode} AND (ur.valid_from IS NULL OR ur.valid_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (ur.valid_to IS NULL OR ur.valid_to >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM permission_conflict_rule cr INNER JOIN role_resource_permission rrp_other ON rrp_other.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND rrp_other.abstract_role_id = ur.abstract_role_id AND rrp_other.resource_entity_id = rrp.resource_entity_id AND rrp_other.delete_flag = 0 AND rrp_other.condition_id IS NULL AND (rrp_other.operation_permission_id = cr.first_operation_permission_id OR rrp_other.operation_permission_id = cr.second_operation_permission_id) WHERE cr.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND cr.delete_flag = 0 AND (cr.resource_type_value IS NULL OR cr.resource_type_value = re.resource_type) AND (cr.biz_domain_id IS NULL OR cr.biz_domain_id = re.biz_domain_id) AND (rrp.operation_permission_id = cr.first_operation_permission_id OR rrp.operation_permission_id = cr.second_operation_permission_id) AND rrp_other.operation_permission_id <> rrp.operation_permission_id )
